meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, or Toutiao drafts through a browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文稿排成公众号图文,配好封面、起好标题再上传草稿。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常在公众号、知乎发文,想把 Markdown 文稿直接排成可发布的图文。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown drafts into WeChat-ready articles with cover art, titles, and saved drafts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you publish to WeChat or Zhihu and want Markdown turned into ready-to-post articles.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行,把你的 Markdown 转成微信公众号排版 HTML,也能预览、检查发布就绪情况、生成封面或信息图、给出标题建议、去除 AI 痕迹,并在你明确要求时上传图片或建草稿。
howto.when: 当你要把 Markdown 排版成公众号文章、做预览,或生成配图、标题建议等时,它接管执行;上传、建草稿、远程生图需你明确要求。

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 排版成公众号 HTML 并预览
给这篇文章出几个公众号标题建议
say.note: 只发出标题生成请求,不写回 Markdown

say.text: 用草稿方式发布这篇文章,并生成一张封面
say.note: 需已配置微信凭据,且草稿必须有封面

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the md2wechat CLI to convert Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML. It can also preview, check readiness, make covers, suggest titles, and upload or draft only when you ask.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want Markdown formatted as a WeChat article, a preview, or generated images, title suggestions, and similar tasks.

say_en.text: Format article.md as WeChat HTML and preview it
say_en.note: Runs inspect then preview; source stays unchanged

say_en.text: Suggest a few WeChat titles for this article
say_en.note: Emits a title prompt only; no write-back

say_en.text: Create a WeChat draft and generate a cover
say_en.note: Needs configured WeChat credentials and a cover
